_comment: ru-code (V2-20): the plugins that SHIP inside the release payload, staged into
apps/server/dist/plugins by `pnpm stage:plugins` (which `pnpm build` runs) and copied
into versions/<v>/plugins by prepare-release, beside client/.
Each entry is a FOLDER PATH, not a package name: the folder that IS the plugin (the SDK
build emits plugin.json at the root of dist/). Relative paths resolve from the app root;
absolute paths are allowed. The folder is copied to <dest>/<manifest id>, so the path's own
basename (`dist`) never reaches the payload — the loader's D8 rule (folder name == id) holds
SKIP RULE: a path that does not exist, is not a directory, has no plugin.json, or whose
plugin.json does not decode is LOGGED and SKIPPED — it never fails the build. A release
carrying no plugins is legal (a fork, a minimal build), so `plugins/` is not a required
member of the payload. Duplicate ids: the first entry wins, the later one is skipped.
`demo` deliberately never ships (V2-21) — it is the dev/e2e fixture.
S55: a path MAY POINT THROUGH A SIBLING-REPO SYMLINK. `ru-code-plugin-auto-coder/dist` is the first one —
that plugin lives in its own repository now (`t3-ru-code/ru-code-plugin-auto-coder`), reached through the
gitignored `ru-code-plugin-auto-coder` link at the app root, exactly as `ru-code-packages` reaches the
packages checkout. Nothing here had to learn about repositories: the entry is still a folder
path, and a clone without the sibling checkout hits the SKIP RULE above and ships without it.
